description: What asking an installed plugin's adapters again came to.

asked.description: Whether its adapters were asked, rather than only said to be.

cleared.description:
Whether every answer kept against the plugin was cleared, which a proof that did
not hold never does.

kept.description: Every answer kept against the plugin when it was proved, which a pass clears.

proofs.description: Each proof asked, or that would be asked, with what it came to.
